title: Family coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-geometric-indices]. An adjunction family assigns an explicit adjunction to every admissible coefficient presentation and every smooth geometric index. Its Brown comparison property means that for every specified right adjunction to the same compact-support functor on the localizing closures, the right functor preserves $P_c$, its restriction has an adjunction whose counit is the underlying Brown counit, and there is a unique natural isomorphism from the family's explicit source to that restriction compatible with those two counits.
